question: g1_delete_item
answer:
Fixed. Here's what was going on:

**Why it fails:** The backend exposes the delete route as `DELETE /api/v1/cart/{code}/product/{sku}`, where the last segment must be the product's **SKU** — `BasketEndpoint.removeLine(String code, String sku, ...)` looks up the cart line by SKU. But `deleteFromCart` was building the URL with `item.id` (the numeric product ID, e.g. `cart/XYZ/product/123`), which matches no cart line, so the request fails and nothing is removed. This was also inconsistent with `addToCart` in the same file, which correctly uses `item.sku` as the product identifier.

**The fix:** In [src/redux/actions/cartActions.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g1_delete_item/okf/codex/1/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js:164), the DELETE URL now uses `item.sku` instead of `item.id`. No other files touched.

**Files used:**
- `okf/index.md` and `okf/modules/src.redux.actions.cartActions.md` — to orient and find the action's dependencies
- `src/redux/actions/cartActions.js` — the buggy code
- `src/util/constant.js`, `src/util/webService.js` — to confirm the URL path built (`cart/{id}/product/...`)
- `src/pages/other/Cart.js` — to confirm what `item` object is passed in
- `okf/references/backend/routes.md` and `okf/references/backend/modules/com.salesmanager.shop.store.api.v1.shoppingCart.md` — to confirm the backend expects `{sku}`, and the `com.salesmanager.shop.model.shoppingcart.md` module doc to confirm cart line items carry a `sku` field

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -il "cart" okf/references/backend | head; echo ===; ls okf/references/backend 2>/dev/null | head -30'
/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n -B3 -A8 "deleteFromCart" src/pages/other/Cart.js | head -40; echo ===; rg -n "sku" src/pages/other/Cart.js | head'
